_comment: Vanzik MCP Gateway config for Zed. Source: https://zed.dev/docs/ai/mcp.html (verified 2026-05-05). Zed calls MCP servers 'context servers' and stores them under the top-level context_servers key inside its main settings.json — NOT inside an mcpServers map. See zed-config.md for the settings.json file path. Do NOT pass --api-key '$VANZIK_API_KEY' literally — Zed does not shell-expand $VAR in JSON args. Inject the key via the env block; the gateway reads VANZIK_API_KEY from the environment when the --api-key flag is absent. --tenant-id selects the tenant whose policy applies; keep 'local' unless you registered another tenant on the server with `vanzik tenant put`. Today the gateway calls only the open /v1/check, so a missing or literal key doesn't stop it working; set the real key anyway, since it is sent as the bearer on every call. --policy is the starter policy a root install of the one-line installer writes; after a user install use the absolute path of ~/.config/vanzik/default.yaml (no ~ expansion here).
